{"id":1982229471,"question_id":4283,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 months","timestamp":1776567908,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"135 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1982229471/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Multi Source Flood Fill","memory":"209.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<vector<int>> colorGrid(int n, int m, vector<vector<int>>& sources) {\n        vector<vector<int>>ans(n , vector<int>(m , 0));\n        vector<vector<int>>dist(n , vector<int>(m , 1e9));\n        \n        queue<pair<int,int>>q;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<sources.size() ; i++){\n            int r = sources[i][0];\n            int c = sources[i][1];\n            int color = sources[i][2];\n            ans[r][c] = color;\n            dist[r][c] = 0;\n            q.push({r,c});\n        }\n\n        vector<int>dr = {-1 , 1 , 0 , 0};\n        vector<int>dc = {0 , 0 , 1 , -1};\n\n        while(!q.empty()){\n            auto [r , c] = q.front();\n            q.pop();\n\n            int curr_color = ans[r][c];\n            int curr_dist = dist[r][c];\n            \n            for(int k = 0 ; k<4 ; k++){\n                int newr = r + dr[k];\n                int newc = c + dc[k];\n\n                if(newr < n and newr >= 0 and newc < m and newc >= 0){\n                    if(curr_dist + 1 < dist[newr][newc]){\n                        ans[newr][newc] = curr_color;\n                        dist[newr][newc] = dist[r][c] + 1;\n                        q.push({newr , newc});\n                    }\n                    else if(curr_dist + 1 == dist[newr][newc]){\n                        ans[newr][newc] = max(curr_color , ans[newr][newc]);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"multi-source-flood-fill","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1930}
